# fresh2go

> Πλατφόρμα delivery φαγητού που συνδέει πελάτες, εστιατόρια και οδηγούς σε πραγματικό χρόνο.

fresh2go is a real-time food delivery platform serving customers, restaurants, and drivers across Greece. Customers browse nearby restaurants, place orders, track deliveries live, and pay online or with cash.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page describing the service for customers, restaurants, and drivers.
- [Browse restaurants](/order): Discover nearby restaurants, search menus, and place orders.
- [Sign in](/auth): Customer, driver, and restaurant sign-in and sign-up.
- [Terms of service](/legal/terms): Terms and conditions for using fresh2go.
- [Privacy policy](/legal/privacy): How fresh2go collects and uses personal data.
